title: The Witnesses
opening: Talented artist Clara Vale is found dead in her studio during her private exhibition. Her devoted assistant Anna is found next to her body with something red on her hands.

suspects.name: Anna
suspects.description: Clara's loyal assistant. She was found kneeling beside Clara's body with a red substance covering her hands.

topics.question: What happened when you found Clara?
topics.answer: Clara was supposed to be downstairs. When she didn't come, I went to the studio to look for her. I found her lying on the floor. I knelt beside her and checked whether she was breathing. Then I screamed.

topics.question: How did the red substance get on your hands?
topics.answer: It was already on the floor beside Clara. I didn't even notice it at first. I knelt down and touched her while checking whether she was alive. That's how it got on my hands.

topics.question: Did Clara say anything unusual tonight?
topics.answer: She seemed tense, but determined. At around nine twenty she told me she was going to make an important announcement later that evening.

topics.question: What do you know about the planned announcement?
topics.answer: She told me it would happen at ten thirty. She wouldn't tell me exactly what she planned to say. She only said it was important and asked me to make sure everyone was together.

topics.question: Was Clara expecting anyone else that evening?
topics.answer: She mentioned that she was waiting for one more person. She said, 'If she comes, everything might finally make sense.' But she wouldn't tell me who it was.

suspects.name: Elliot
suspects.description: A longtime friend of Clara and a struggling artist. Several guests witnessed a heated argument between them earlier that evening.

topics.question: What happened during your argument with Clara?
topics.answer: We argued. That's hardly a secret. Clara had a habit of treating struggling artists like failures who simply hadn't worked hard enough. I lost my temper.

topics.question: Did you speak to Clara again after the argument?
topics.answer: No. I stayed downstairs with everyone else. I didn't go near her studio.

topics.question: Then why was your sketchbook in Clara's studio?
topics.answer: Fine. I went up there. But she was alive when I left. I needed her help. My career is going nowhere, and Clara knows everyone who matters. I asked her to introduce my work to a gallery. I didn't want anyone to know I'd gone crawling to her for help after shouting at her in front of everyone.

topics.question: What's that red stain on your sleeve?
topics.answer: Paint. What else would it be? I was in Clara's studio earlier, remember? She was working on a painting while we talked. I must have brushed against something.

topics.question: The paint on your sleeve looks like the paint beside Clara's body. How do you explain that?
topics.answer: Because Clara was using that paint when I visited her! I was standing right beside her workspace. I don't remember exactly what I touched. I left her studio before ten. She was alive when I walked out.

topics.question: Your fingerprints were found on the bronze sculpture. Why did you touch it?
topics.answer: I picked it up while we were talking. I was nervous, and I needed something to do with my hands. Clara told me to put it down, so I did. I didn't hit her with it! She was alive when I left.

suspects.name: Julian Mercer
suspects.description: A successful artist and one of Clara's closest friends for more than fifteen years. He was seen leaving Clara's studio not long before she was found dead.

other_people.name: Gideon Crane
other_people.description: Clara's eccentric spiritual therapist. He believes Clara had been deeply troubled in the weeks before her death.

other_people.name: Daniel
other_people.description: A guest who was attending Clara's exhibition and spent part of the evening near the garden.

topics.question: Did you notice anything unusual near the garden?
topics.answer: Around ten, I noticed a woman near the garden entrance. I didn't recognize her, but I only saw her briefly.

topics.question: Could the woman you saw have been Mara?
topics.answer: Possibly. Now that I've seen that old photograph, she looks a little familiar. But it was dark, and I couldn't see her face clearly.

evidence.name: Clara's Body
evidence.description: Clara Vale lies motionless on the floor of her studio. There is an apparent head injury.

evidence.name: Red Substance
evidence.description: A pool of deep red substance lies near Clara's body. The same substance covers Anna's hands.

evidence.name: Bronze Sculpture
evidence.description: A heavy bronze sculpture is found near Clara's body.

evidence.name: Elliot's Sketchbook
evidence.description: A worn sketchbook is partially hidden among Clara's painting supplies. The name 'Elliot' is written inside the cover.

evidence.name: Old Group Photograph
evidence.description: An old photograph shows a much younger Clara standing with Julian, Elliot and an unfamiliar young woman. The four appear to be close friends.

evidence.name: Old Plagiarism Article
evidence.description: An archived newspaper article from fifteen years ago discusses a plagiarism scandal involving the artist Mara. The article includes a photograph identifying Mara as the fourth member of Clara's old artistic circle.

evidence.name: Clara and Mara's Messages
evidence.description: A printed exchange of recent messages between Clara and Mara. Mara writes, 'You had fifteen years to listen to me,' and 'If I come tonight, it won't be to forgive you.'

evidence.name: Unlocked Back Entrance
evidence.description: The back door is unlocked. Someone could have entered the house through the garden without passing the main entrance.

clues.name: Crimson Oil Paint
clues.description: The red substance beside Clara's body and on Anna's hands is crimson oil paint, not blood.

clues.name: Anna Discovered Clara
clues.description: Anna says she went to the studio when Clara failed to return downstairs and found Clara lying on the floor.

clues.name: Anna's Red Hands
clues.description: Anna says the red substance got onto her hands when she knelt beside Clara and checked whether she was alive.

clues.name: Clara's Planned Announcement
clues.description: Clara told Anna that she intended to make an important announcement later that evening.

clues.name: 22:30 Announcement
clues.description: Clara's planned announcement was supposed to take place at 22:30.

clues.name: Disturbing Drawing of Clara
clues.description: One page of Elliot's sketchbook contains an angry drawing of Clara with her face heavily crossed out.

clues.name: Elliot's Public Threat
clues.description: Several guests heard Elliot tell Clara, 'You won't be laughing at me after tonight,' during their argument.

clues.name: Elliot Denies Visiting the Studio
clues.description: Elliot claims he did not privately visit Clara in her studio after their public argument.

clues.name: Elliot Admits Visiting the Studio
clues.description: After being confronted about his sketchbook, Elliot admits that he secretly visited Clara in her studio from approximately 21:42 to 21:51.

clues.name: Elliot Asked Clara for Help
clues.description: Elliot says he privately asked Clara to use her influence to help his struggling career. He lied about the visit because he was embarrassed and feared it would make him look guilty.

clues.name: Clara's Fatal Injury
clues.description: Examination of Clara's body indicates that she died from a severe blunt-force injury to the head.

clues.name: Probable Murder Weapon
clues.description: The bronze sculpture's shape and weight are consistent with Clara's fatal head injury. It is likely the murder weapon.

clues.name: Elliot's Fingerprints
clues.description: Elliot's fingerprints were recovered from the bronze sculpture believed to have killed Clara.

clues.name: Paint on Elliot's Clothing
clues.description: A visible stain of deep crimson paint is present on Elliot's sleeve.

clues.name: Similar Crimson Paint
clues.description: The paint on Elliot's sleeve looks very similar to the crimson oil paint found beside Clara's body. A visual comparison alone does not establish that it came from the same source.

clues.name: Elliot's Explanation for His Fingerprints
clues.description: Elliot says he handled the bronze sculpture during his earlier visit to Clara's studio, while Clara was still alive.

clues.name: The Fourth Artist
clues.description: An old photograph shows Clara, Julian, Elliot and an unidentified young woman together approximately fifteen years ago.

clues.name: Mara — The Fourth Artist
clues.description: The unidentified woman in the old group photograph is Mara, an artist who belonged to the same circle as Clara, Julian and Elliot fifteen years ago.

clues.name: The Plagiarism Scandal
clues.description: Fifteen years ago, Mara was publicly accused of plagiarizing Julian's artwork. Clara defended Julian, and Mara's artistic career collapsed following the scandal.

clues.name: Mara's Anger
clues.description: In recent messages, Mara expresses deep resentment toward Clara for defending Julian fifteen years earlier.

clues.name: Mara Might Attend
clues.description: Mara's messages suggest that she was considering attending Clara's exhibition that evening.

clues.name: Unknown Woman Near the Garden
clues.description: Daniel reports seeing an unfamiliar woman near the garden entrance at approximately 22:00.

clues.name: Possible Mara Sighting
clues.description: After seeing Mara in an old photograph, Daniel thinks the woman near the garden may have resembled her, although he is uncertain.

clues.name: Possible Secret Entrance
clues.description: The back entrance was found unlocked, providing a possible route into the house without being seen by guests at the front entrance. There is no proof that anyone used it.

clues.name: Clara Expected Another Guest
clues.description: Anna says Clara was expecting one more person to attend the exhibition, although she did not reveal the person's identity.

locations.name: Clara's Studio
locations.description: Clara's private workspace on the upper floor. Her body was discovered here.

areas.name: Clara's Body
areas.description: Clara lies motionless on the studio floor.

areas.name: Floor Around the Body
areas.description: The area immediately surrounding Clara's body.

areas.name: Clara's Desk
areas.description: A large wooden desk covered with papers, letters and art materials.

areas.name: Painting Area
areas.description: Paints, brushes, unfinished canvases and other supplies fill this side of the studio.

locations.name: Exhibition Gallery
locations.description: The room where Clara's new collection, The Witnesses, is being displayed. Alongside the paintings is a small retrospective of her earlier artistic career.

areas.name: The Witnesses Collection
areas.description: Clara's latest paintings fill the gallery. Strange figures, obscured faces and fragmented identities appear throughout the collection.

areas.name: Archive Display
areas.description: An assortment of old photographs, newspaper clippings and exhibition catalogues documents Clara's early career.

locations.name: Dining Room
locations.description: The main dining room where Clara and her guests ate earlier that evening.

locations.name: Upstairs Hallway
locations.description: A corridor that connects Clara's studio to the rest of the house.

locations.name: Back Garden
locations.description: A quiet garden behind Clara's house. A narrow path leads to the back entrance.

areas.name: Back Entrance
areas.description: A side door connects the garden to the house. It is away from the main entrance where guests arrived.

areas.name: Garden Path
areas.description: A narrow stone path runs alongside the house.
